svg.title: Two timelines on every fact
svg.desc: Three stored facts on a timeline from March to September 2026, each with two bars: when it was true in the world (valid_at to invalid_at) and when the graph held it (created_at to expired_at). 'Strictly vegetarian for eight years' is true from 14 March, the day it was said, until 20 July, and held over the same days. 'Started following a pescatarian diet about a month ago' is true from 20 July and held from 20 July; the user meant about 20 June, but the model dated it by the message. When it arrived, code ended the vegetarian fact where the new one starts. 'Moved to Kreuzberg in May' is true from 1 May but held only from 20 July, when it was said. A line at 15 April crosses only the vegetarian fact; a line at 1 September crosses the pescatarian fact and Kreuzberg.
svg.text: Every fact carries two date ranges: when it was true in the world, and when the graph held it. A contradicted fact is not
deleted; it gets an end date, so a question about any day becomes a filter.
said: “for eight years”, so since about 2018
Started a pescatarian diet about a month ago
said: “about a month ago”, so about 20 June
true from 1 May; known from 20 July
the model, in step 3, from the message and its date
code, when a newer fact contradicts it
code, when the message is stored
when the graph stopped holding it
code, when the fact is closed
Here created_at and expired_at are set to the time of each message, as if every session were stored on the day it happened; in a live system they
are the clock time of storing.
